image_description: A black non-stick frying pan sits on a gas stovetop burner. The pan contains a white, foamy liquid (likely boiling water or oil) covering the bottom. In the background, there is a red container with white text and a metallic jar lid. The lighting is somewhat dim, creating reflections on the wet surface of the pan's contents.

The intersection of the pan bottom and the stove grate is slightly ambiguous; the grate bars seem to fade or merge softly into the shadow beneath the pan rather than casting sharp, distinct shadows.
